summary: Eni S.p.A. filed its interim consolidated report as of June 30, 2026, on Form 6-K. The report covers routine operational and financial results, including production growth, a JV with Petronas, and an acquisition agreement in Argentina. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign is announced. This is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer, filed as a 6-K, with no transformative corporate action disclosed.
